pairs: Nonne David absconditus est apud nos?
“Has not David been hidden with us?”
in nomine tuo salvum me fac,
et in virtute tua judica me.
and judge me in your virtue.
Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
For strangers have risen up against me,
and the strong have sought my soul.
et non proposuerunt Deum ante conspectum suum.
And they have not set God before their eyes.
For behold, God is my helper,
et Dominus susceptor est animæ meæ.
and the Lord is the protector of my soul.
Turn back the evils upon my adversaries,
et in veritate tua disperde illos.
and ruin them by your truth.
I will freely sacrifice to you,
and I will confess your name,
Quoniam ex omni tribulatione eripuisti me,
For you have quickly rescued me from all tribulation,
et super inimicos meos despexit oculus meus.
and my eye has looked down upon my enemies.
